title: 7-Day Comfort Zone Expansion
description: Your comfort zone isn't comfortable — it's familiar. This program helps you expand beyond it.
outcomes: Take small risks outside your comfort zone
Build confidence in your ability to handle discomfort

days.title: The Comfort Zone Map
days.insight: What's inside your comfort zone? What feels safe? What's outside? Identify the boundary.
days.action: Draw your comfort zone. What's inside? What's outside? What would it take to step outside today?

days.title: The Small Risk
days.insight: You don't need to skydive to expand your comfort zone. Start small.
days.action: Do one thing today that's slightly outside your comfort zone. Talk to a stranger. Try something new.
days.reflectionQuestion: What's a small risk I can take today?

days.title: The Discomfort Log
days.insight: When you feel discomfort, log it. Notice: the discomfort passes. You're still okay.
days.action: When you feel discomfort today, pause and log: What am I feeling? How intense is it? How long does it last?
days.reflectionQuestion: What did I feel uncomfortable about today?

days.title: The Novelty Challenge
days.insight: Novelty expands your comfort zone. Change creates growth.
days.action: Change one small thing about your routine today. Take a different route. Try a different food.
days.reflectionQuestion: What can I change in my routine today?

days.title: The 'No' Practice
days.insight: Saying 'no' is a skill. Practice it. It's okay to set boundaries.
days.action: Say 'no' to one thing today. It can be small — 'no' to an extra commitment, 'no' to a distraction.
days.reflectionQuestion: What can I say 'no' to today?

days.title: The Challenge Response
days.insight: When faced with a challenge, your default might be to retreat. Practice responding differently.
days.action: When faced with a challenge today, pause. Ask: 'What's the brave thing to do?' Then do that.
days.reflectionQuestion: What would the brave version of me do?

days.title: The Expansion
days.insight: Your comfort zone expands when you push the boundaries. Celebrate your growth.
days.action: Write down three things you did this week that were outside your comfort zone. Celebrate them.
days.reflectionQuestion: How has my comfort zone expanded this week?
